section: Moving and setting up the appliance
markdown:
| Activity                                                                                                                                                             | Materials used                                       | Personal protective equipment                                                                            |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Conveying within the establishment Setting up the appliance on a work surface, stand or in a stacking trolley. Setting up the appliance in the installation location | Suitable lifting gear Forklift truck or pallet truck | Protective gloves Safety boots Hard hat (e.g., when heavy loads are being lifted, working overhead, ...) |
